lesson.description: Learn the key ideas for both sides in the Two Knights Defense.

{Black has allowed White to play the Fried Liver Attack. How can White
sacrifice for a strong attack?} 6. Nxf7 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to
find it and check the hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Sacrifice your knight to
lure the black king forward.]} (6. d4 $5 {This is a good move, but there's an
even better one. Try to find it.}) (6. Bxd5 $2 Qxd5 {Black is doing well. Try
to find a better move.}) 6... Kxf7 {Great move! How should you take advantage
of the exposed black king?} 7. Qf3+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to
find a precise check.] [%hint Fork Black's king and the d5 knight.]} (7. Qh5+
$2 Kg8 {Black is better. Try to find a stronger check.}) (7. Bxd5+ $2 Qxd5 {
White doesn't have compensation for the sacrificed piece. Try to find a better
check.}) 7... Ke6 {Great move! How should White develop and continue to attack
the pinned knight?} 8. Nc3 {[%wrong Black is doing well. Try to find a strong
developing move.] [%hint Develop a knight to attack d5.] Great job! We will
examine how the attack might end in the next challenge.} (8. Qg4+ $2 Kd6 {
Black is better. Try again.}) 1-0

{How can White force checkmate in three moves from this Fried Liver Attack
game?} 14. Nb6+ {[%wrong There's a faster path to mate. Try to find it.] 
[%hint Play a discovered check and defend the d7 square.]} (14. Nb4+ $5 {
This is a good move, but there's a faster path to mate. Try to find it.}) (14.
Ne7+ $5 {This is a good move, but there's a faster path to mate. Try to find
it.}) (14. dxe5 $5 {This is a good move, but there's a faster path to mate.
Try to find it.}) (14. Nf6+ $2 Ke7 {White is winning, but there's a better
move. Try to find it.}) 14... Nb3 {Great choice! How can you checkmate in two
moves?} 15. Bxb3+ {[%wrong There's a faster path to mate. Try to find it.] 
[%hint Capture the knight on b3.]} (15. Qxb3+ $5 {This is a great move but
there's a faster path to mate. Try to find it.}) 15... Ke7 {Great move!
Where's the mate?} 16. Qf7# {[%wrong That's not mate. Try again.] [%hint Look
at your checks. Which one is mate.] Great attacking play!} 1-0

{White's Nc3 move allows the famous "Fork Trick." How can Black play it?} 4...
Nxe4 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a strong and
temporary sacrifice.] [%hint Sacrifice a knight for a pawn and then use a fork
to win it back.]} (4... Bc5 $5 {This is a reasonable, developing move, but
there's a good capture as well. Try to find it.}) (4... d6 $2 5. Ng5 {Black
has no good defense to White's threats against the f7-pawn. Try again and look
for a more forcing option.}) (4... h6 $2 5. d4 {White has more active pieces
and a slight advantage. Try again and look for a more forcing option.}) (4...
Be7 $2 5. O-O {White has more active pieces and a slight advantage. Try again
and look for a more forcing option.}) 5. Nxe4 {We will examine Bxf7+ in the
next challenge. How should Black win back the sacrificed material after Nxe4?}
d5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good fork.] [%hint
Fork White's bishop and the e4-knight.]} 6. Bxd5 {Good idea! What's next?} Qxd5
{[%wrong White keeps a material advantage. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Capture a piece.] Well played! Black has good center control
and the better position.} *

{White's Bxf7+ option against the fork trick might look scary, but Black can
reach an excellent position with precise play. How should you escape the check?
} 5... Kxf7 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Capture the bishop.]} (5... Ke7 $2 {White keeps an extra pawn
and has the safer king as well. Try to find a stronger option.}) 6. Nxe4 {
Good start! How can you take over the center?} d5 {[%wrong There's a better
move. Try to find a good threat.] [%hint Dominate the center with pawns and
make a threat.]} (6... Kg8 $2 7. c4 {White fights for the center with a
roughly even game. Try again and look for a way to dominate the center right
away.}) (6... h6 $2 7. Nxe5+ {White prepares to meet Nxe5 with Qh5+ and Black
has to be extremely careful. Try again and look for a more forcing option.}) (
6... Be7 $2 7. d4 {White has a dangerous attack. Try again and look for a
strong threat.}) (6... Ke8 $2 7. d4 {White has a dangerous attack. Try again
and look for a strong threat.}) 7. Neg5+ {Good move! How should you save your
king?} Kg8 {[%wrong White has a powerful attack against the exposed black king.
Try again and look for a safer move.] [%hint Hide your king on the back rank
behind a pawn.] Great job! The Black's exposed king is only a temporary
problem, while the big center and bishop pair are long-term advantages.} (7...
Ke8 $2 8. d4 {Black is only slightly better as the king can get in trouble on
e8. Try to find a safer king move.}) *

{Black has sacrificed a pawn and attacked the white bishop on c4. How should
White keep an advantage?} 6. Bf1 {[%wrong Black will soon win material. Try
again and look for a strong bishop move.] [%hint Retreat your bishop to defend
the g2-pawn.]} (6. Bxb5 $2 Qxd5 {Black forks b5 and g2 with a good position.
Try again and look for a better bishop move.}) (6. Be2 $2 Nd4 {Black defends
b5 and targets the white bishop with good counterplay. Try again and look for
a stronger bishop move.}) (6. Bb3 $2 Nd4 {Black defends b5 and targets the
white bishop with good counterplay. Try again and look for a stronger bishop
move.}) (6. Bd3 $2 Qxd5 {Black wins back the sacrificed pawn and attacks g2.
Try again and look for a better bishop move.}) (6. dxc6 $2 bxc4 {Black wins
the bishop pair and achieves good counterplay. Try again and look for a strong
bishop move.}) 6... Qxd5 {Great move! Black only wins back the pawn
temporarily. How should White win material?} 7. Nc3 {[%wrong Black is doing
well. Try again and look for a strong fork.] [%hint Develop to fork Black's
queen and the b5-pawn.]} Qc5 {Good choice! How should you win material?} 8.
Bxb5 {[%wrong Black has a safe position. Try again and look for a good capture.
] [%hint Capture a pawn and prepare to castle.] Great work! Black will have a
difficult time demonstrating compensation for the sacrificed pawn.} (8. Nxb5
$2 Qb6 {It's stronger to develop a piece while capturing on b5. How should you
do it?}) *

{Black's queen and rook are stuck in a fork, but it's White who's in trouble.
Try to find Black's winning move.} 7... Qc6 {[%wrong There's a better move.
Try again and look for the perfect spot for your queen.] [%hint Use your
queen to fork c4 and g2.]} (7... Qc5 $2 8. Na3 {White defends the bishop with
a good position. Try again and look for a better queen move.}) (7... Qe7 $2 8.
Nxh8 {White defends the bishop with a good position. Try again and look for a
better queen move.}) (7... Qd7 $2 8. Nxh8 {White defends the bishop with a
good position. Try again and look for a better queen move.}) (7... Qb4 $2 8.
Na3 {White defends the bishop with a good position. Try again and look for a
better queen move.}) 8. Nxh8 {White wins a rook, but now it's Black's turn to
attack. How can you win material?} Qxg2 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try
again and look for a winning capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn and attack a rook.
]} (8... Qxc4 $2 9. c3 {Black's doing well, but there's a much better capture.
Try to find it.}) (8... Bg4 $2 9. f3 {White has good chances for a successful
defense. Try again and look for a strong capture.}) 9. Rf1 {Good idea! How
should you target the white king?} Qe4+ {[%wrong There's a better option. Try
again and look for a good check.] [%hint Find a check and make white block it.]
} (9... Bg4 $5 {This is a good move, but there's a check that often leads to a
quick mate. Try to find it.}) (9... Bf5 $5 {This is a good move, but there's a
check that often leads to a quick mate. Try to find it.}) (9... Bc5 $5 {
This is a good move, but there's a check that often leads to a quick mate. Try
to find it.}) (9... Bh3 $5 {This is a good move, but there's a check that
often leads to a quick mate. Try to find it.}) (9... Nf3+ $5 {This is a fine
move, but another check is even stronger. Try to find it.}) 10. Be2 {White
should have given away the queen because now there's mate. Where is it?} Nf3# {
[%wrong There's a checkmate, but that's not it. Try again.] [%hint Look at
your checks. Which one is mate?] What a beautiful final position!} *

{White's up material, but Black will soon win a piece. How should you do it?} 
10... Qd4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a strong fork.
] [%hint Fork the only two developed white pieces.]} (10... Bd6 $2 11. Nxc6 {
Black has good compensation for the sacrificed material, but another option
will gain an clear advantage. Try to find a way to win material.}) (10... Qd5
$2 11. d4 {White keeps a material advantage. Try again and look for a strong
fork.}) (10... Bb7 $6 11. d4 {White keeps a material advantage. Try again and
look for a strong fork.}) (10... Bd7 $2 11. Nxd7 {White keeps a material
advantage. Try again and look for a strong fork.}) 11. Bxc6+ {Good start!
What's next?} Nxc6 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a
good capture.] [%hint Capture a piece to escape the check.]} 12. Nxc6 {Good
choice! How should you save your queen?} Qd5 {[%wrong There's a better move.
Try again and look for a way to trap the white knight.] [%hint Centralize your
queen and trap White's knight.] Well played! White has no way to save the
c6-knight.} (12... Qc5 $5 {This is a good option. See if you can find another
queen move to trap the white knight without blocking a bishop temporarily.}) (
12... Qd6 $2 13. Na5 {Black is doing well, but there's a stronger queen move
to quickly trap the white knight. How should you do it?}) (12... Qb6 $2 13. Ne5
{White's knight escapes danger and Black is only slightly better. Try again
and look for a better queen move.}) *

{How did GM Harikrishna take advantage of his active position and win material?
} 23... Rxc6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good
attacking option.] [%hint Sacrifice an exchange to eliminate the threat
against d8.]} (23... Bb4 $5 {This is a good move, but GM Harikrishna preferred
to start with a capture. What was his idea?}) (23... Bh2+ $2 24. Kxh2 {Black
can win back a piece on d2, but there's a better attacking move. Try to find
it.}) (23... Rd7 $2 24. Qc1 {White keeps an OK position. Try again and look
for a more forcing option.}) (23... Re8 $2 24. Be3 {White keeps a safe
position. Try again and look for a more forcing option.}) (23... Rf8 $2 24.
Bxh6 {White uses a discovered attack against d6 to win material. Try again and
look for a better attacking option.}) 24. Bxc6 {Good start! How should you win
back the sacrificed material with interest?} Bb4 {[%wrong There's a better
option. Try to find a way to use a pin to win material.] [%hint Use a pin to
win material on the d-file.]} (24... Bf4 $2 25. Bc3 {White attacks the black
queen and rook and keeps a material advantage. Try again and look for a better
option.}) (24... Bc5 $2 25. Re2 {White is OK. Try again and look for a
stronger bishop move.}) 25. Qf3 {Nice move! How should you win material?} Bxd2
{[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint
Capture a piece and make a threat.] Well played! Black soon won in Zeng -
Harikrishna, 2018. You can examine a possible variation in the next challenge.}
(25... Rxd2 $2 26. Qxf5 {White keeps a material advantage. Try again and look
for a stronger capture.}) (25... Qxd2 $2 26. Qxf5 {White keeps a material
advantage. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) *

{How can Black sacrifice material and start a powerful kingside attack?} 11...
Nxg2 {[%wrong There's a better attacking option. Try to find it and check the
hint if you're stuck.] [%hint Sacrifice a piece to expose the white king.]} (
11... e4 $5 {This is a good move, but it's even better when prepared with a
strong sacrifice. Try to find it.}) (11... Nxe2+ $2 12. Qxe2 {White is
slightly better. Try again and look for a stronger attacking option. Feel free

sacrifice a knight. How should you do it?}) 12. Kxg2 {Great move! How can you
justify the sacrifice?} e4 {[%wrong There's a better attacking option. Try
again and look for a useful threat.] [%hint Attack the f3-knight.]} 13. Ne1 {
Good choice! White would have been better off sacrificing the knight. Now
Black has a winning move. What should you play?} Qg5+ {[%wrong There's a
stronger move. Try again and look for a way to include your queen in the
attack.] [%hint Find a safe check.]} (13... Qh4 $2 14. f4 {Black is doing well,
but there's a much stronger attacking queen move. Try to find it.}) (13... Qf6
$2 14. f4 {Black doesn't have compensation for the sacrificed material. Try

a better attacking option.}) (13... Qd7 $2 14. Kh1 {Black doesn't have
compensation for the sacrificed material. Try again and look for a better
attacking option.}) 14. Kh1 {Nice move! How can you force checkmate?} Qf4 {
[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a way to force
checkmate.] [%hint Make a battery against the h2-pawn.]} (14... Qh4 $2 15. f4 {
White keeps a material advantage. Try again and look for a better way to
threaten mate on h2.}) (14... Qe5 $2 15. f4 {White keeps a material advantage.
Try again and look for a better way to threaten mate on h2.}) 15. Nf3 {Great
move! What's next?} exf3 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look
for a good capture.] [%hint Capture the piece that's defending checkmate.]} (
15... Bg4 $5 {This is a good move, but there's a faster path to mate. Try to
find it.}) 16. Bxf3 {Almost there! Where's the checkmate?} Qxh2# {[%wrong
